description.zh: bm 词：搜 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 的书签（含账户书签），支持拼音，Enter 打开；在设置里打开后，bh 词 搜浏览历史
description.en: bm words: searches Chrome, Edge and Firefox bookmarks, account ones too, by pinyin as well; Enter opens. Once turned on in the settings, bh words searches the browsing history

description.zh: 搜 Chrome / Edge / Firefox 的书签（含账户书签），可用拼音
description.en: Search Chrome / Edge / Firefox bookmarks, account ones too, pinyin works

hint.zh: 书签的名字、文件夹或网址里的词；名字和文件夹是汉字的话也可以打拼音
hint.en: words of a bookmark's name, folder or address; pinyin for Chinese names and folders too

ai.description: Search the user's Chrome, Edge and Firefox bookmarks (the local list and the signed-in account's) by words in the title or URL; each item has the title, the folder and the URL (open.url).

description.zh: 搜 Chrome / Edge / Firefox 打开过的网页，可用拼音；要先在设置里打开
description.en: Search the pages opened in Chrome / Edge / Firefox, pinyin works; turned on in the settings first

hint.zh: 网页标题或网址里的词，标题是汉字的话也可以打拼音；不打字是最近打开的网页
hint.en: words of a page's title or address, pinyin for Chinese titles too; nothing typed lists the pages last opened

ai.description: Search the user's Chrome, Edge and Firefox browsing history by words in the page title or URL (only when the user has turned this on in the plugin's settings); each item has the title, the browser, when it was last opened and the URL (open.url). An empty query lists the most recently opened pages.

hint.zh: 打开后，bh 词 搜 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 打开过的网页（只在这台电脑上读，不上传）；开了“AI 可以使用插件”的话，AI 也能查。关着时不读历史
hint.en: On: bh words searches the pages opened in Chrome, Edge and Firefox (read on this PC only, sent nowhere); with "AI may use plugins" on, an AI can search it too. Off: the history is not read

hint.zh: Chromium 系浏览器的 Bookmarks 文件（Brave、Vivaldi…），或 Firefox 系浏览器的 places.sqlite（LibreWolf、Zen…），和 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 的一起搜
hint.en: A Chromium browser's Bookmarks file (Brave, Vivaldi …) or a Firefox-like browser's places.sqlite (LibreWolf, Zen …), searched with Chrome's, Edge's and Firefox's
